how: checks/web_wf20_parity.py (enumeration on main) and by hand: the class 2(6Y) mod 5 of each field is its exterior degree mod 5 for the standard embedding (matter in classes 2 and 4, the Higgs and its conjugate in 1 and 4); there are four conjugation-odd functions on the four classes; exactly two put all matter in one class for both signs of the hypercharge convention, and they are complements; each gives (up S~, down S, leptons S) for both signs; exterior-degree parity is one of the two; with the Higgs entering as an operator of degree +1 or -1 both its components are odd and the rule gives S~ three times, against the charge rule. The standard facts used are standard: the centre of SU(5) acts on Lambda^k by zeta^k; 16 x 16 = 10 + 120 + 126; SL(2, Z/5) is perfect
